svg.title: StockResearchAgents layered component architecture
svg.desc: CLI, MCP, and Python adapters use StockResearchApplication for completed reads, responses, cohort evaluation, and diagnostics, and use dedicated application command functions for plan, import, and lifecycle mutations. ApplicationRuntime composes the application from StateLayout and focused durable ports. CompanyAnalyticsCoordinator owns lifecycle sequencing and delegates recoverable completed publication to CompletedPublicationSaga. Contracts, deterministic analytics, and validation remain domain-owned. Completed bundles feed projection-only readers, while backup-first migration and redacted doctor remain operational paths.
